title: The Fake Rosette at Pine Hollow
intro: The campground's prize rosette for the best campfire tale has been swapped for a cheap plastic copy, and the real one is nowhere to be found.

suspects.name: Marta
suspects.line: I was toasting marshmallows all evening. Ask anyone sticky.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I was reading in my tent, quietly, for hours.

suspects.name: Rudy
suspects.line: Yes, I was near the judges' table. So was everyone.

suspects.name: Sol
suspects.line: I was at the washroom block. Long line, sorry.

suspects.name: Otis
suspects.line: I only went to the lake to fish. Caught nothing, sadly.

clues.text: The culprit was not spotted at the lakeside dock. Our sign-out sheet shows nobody from that bench left a trace near the water that night.
The culprit was not seen wandering tent row at the time of the swap. The lantern-watch logbook shows that row stayed quiet and empty all evening.
Fresh mud on the gloves of the one who swapped the rosette. Whoever reached into the case had clearly been digging in the wet garden beds.
Those inky fingerprints on the case glass don't belong to the culprit. Ink stains were left by someone who only scribbled a story, so they can be ruled out.
